messages:
maya: Heads-up  I want a single long-term doc that ties routing policy, tenancy lanes, canary gates, and launch criteria for the architecture review. Owners + draft by next Wed.

sam: Agreed. Proposal: keep the policy tiny and executable. Primitives: lane_id, residency_requirement, fallback_priority, model_family_constraints, quality_budget_pct.

jana: Customer feedback to include: residency clauses, latency guarantees, reserved capacity options. I'll add 3 archetypes with contract wording.

rolf: Ops redline: block pinned-region canaries until per-tenant telemetry + eviction automation exist. Pre-canary probes: p50/p95/p99, eviction_rate, kv_cache_hit, capacity_headroom. If missing -> block. :no_entry:

ben: Prioritization: I'll run impact vs effort vs infra_risk. Will weight customer_impact higher and surface a short heatmap for PI planning.

sam: Tiny sample policy (WIP):
```
lane_id: premium-1
residency: eu-west-1 (hard)
fallback_priority: [regional_affinity, shared_pool]
model_family_constraints: { quant_ok: true, f16_ok: false }
quality_budget_pct: 2
rollout: [feature_flag_canary, small_ab, gradual_ramp]
```
Runtime must pick compatible model_variant at route time.

taylor: I'll build a 2-slide summary + gating checklist for the review. Meeting Thurs 9am?

maya: Thurs 9am works. Deploy-bot, can you scaffold a doc + branch for owners to PR?

deploy-bot: created doc https://redwood.internal/docs/longterm-tenancy-roadmap-draft and branch routing/longterm-3954321000

maya: Thanks all  please add notes to the doc by EOD Tue so I can synthesize.
